title: A Benchmark to Assess Common Ground in Human-AI Collaboration
one_sentence: 提供已经存在的 human–AI common-ground benchmark precedent，覆盖 joint action、referential coordination、repair 与 situation awareness。
problem: 如何让 human–AI common ground 由可重复任务与多层指标测量，而不只数 surface grounding acts？
method: 设计 collaborative puzzle benchmark，并以 2×2 role×shared-view、N=40 UK participants 与 GPT-4.1 的 confirmatory study 验证 task、communication 与 object-level measures。
findings: Benchmark 重现若干 human-human grounding 理论预期，并暴露 human–AI divergences。
GPT-4.1 常不延续 clarification、难以保持 puzzle state，也不适应 participant vocabulary；shared view 可支持部分 repair。
real_contribution: 消除‘没有 human–AI common-ground benchmark’这一宽泛 gap，并为 residual embodied diagnostic battery 提供 closest work。
biggest_weakness: preprint、N=40、单模型、text/puzzle setting；尚无 partner-history ablation、partner swap、cross-task transfer 或 physical embodiment。
claim_boundary: 证明 benchmark 组件已存在，不证明 common ground 已被可靠测尽或模型差异可跨任务泛化。
why_researcher_should_care: AMSC 的 benchmark novelty 必须从 generic absence 转向整合 partner-specificity、repair、transfer 与 embodiment。
evidence_notes: arXiv v1 from February 2026; outside the strict seven-day window and labeled first-run recovery.
Full preprint method, participant design, measures, and conclusion were audited.
